summary: flume friction's bare list escapes an unstattable note as a raw stack at exit 1, and its --help omits the 74 the verb already returns
acceptance: src/cli.ts:758's statSync refuses behind the same EX_IOERR arm as the verb's readdir (746) and named-note read (723); HELP_SUB.friction names 74.
tests: flume friction refuses with EX_IOERR when a listed note cannot be stat'd
flume friction --help names exit 74 for an I/O failure in the channel dir
notes: Repro measured this tick: chmod 444 on the channel dir — readdirSync succeeds, statSync throws EACCES. Uncaught it reaches main().catch, so the one detectable I/O failure in the CLI that still reads as a harness bug. 723 and 746 already return 74, so the help omission stands on its own.
